hypothesis: Freeze production 4H structural SL/TP after first trend/breakout/retest/strict 15M confirmation. Later pullback to net RR >=2 may add profitable filled setups without widening stop or lowering confirmation quality.

rules.confirmation: unchanged production colour AND strict close beyond roll, plus retest
rules.stop_target: freeze original structural levels; TP must be beyond roll; never widen SL or invent TP
rules.signal_time: signal close +1ms sentinel, excludes signal candle
rules.duplicates: first qualified confirmation per setup, never rearm expired/invalidated/gap setups
rules.invalidation: 4 bars expiry or next known trend/setup invalidation
rules.fill: later bar touch, opening through SL invalidates; assumed fill still needs net RR>=2
rules.fill_candle: any TP/SL touch AMBIGUOUS; no inference about TP-before-fill
rules.outcome: closed contiguous later bars; both TP/SL AMBIGUOUS; gap stops evaluation

portfolio.quantity: reserve at creation using net stop risk and known cash; round observed size step; no future profit increases
portfolio.uncertain: freeze capital on ambiguous result/gap; equity and ROI unknown

decision.kill: any sufficiently sampled period net AvgR<=0 or PF<=1
decision.continue: both periods>=20, positive net AvgR and PF>1, additional fills vs current; then forward Shadow required
decision.roi: capped portfolio realized cash return, separate from expectancy R; disclose open/uncertain exposure

limitations: Recent live context already seen: validation is not a pristine holdout.
Touch execution is hypothetical; tick prices, spread, liquidity and queue not validated.
Funding not modeled; research cannot justify live promotion.
Previous measured-move and EMA-pullback failures remain recorded.
